summary: Plugins in a collection are documented the same way as modules, using DOCUMENTATION, EXAMPLES and RETURN blocks.
questions: How do I document a plugin in my collection?
Do plugins use the same doc blocks as modules?

answer_card.title: Documenting plugins
answer_card.answer_md: Document plugins the same way as modules, with `DOCUMENTATION`, `EXAMPLES` and `RETURN` blocks. See the module documentation guide for details.
